en.description:
Your little arcade, always close at hand.

Crownook brings 30 distinct games to Apple Watch, all included with one paid download. Turn the Digital Crown, tap to play and find a game for a short break.

RACE, REEL AND REACT
Dodge traffic in Crown Rally, find your rhythm in Stack Tower, reel in fish, defend an orbit or land a spacecraft. Try golf, bowling, bouncing shots and a timeline you can rewind.

MAKE YOUR NEXT MOVE
Connect circuits, merge numbers, uncover mines and solve compact Sudoku. Play memory, word, number, train-routing and tactical challenges, with short rules and touch controls.

A LITTLE PROGRESS, EVERY VISIT
Continue a saved run, chase personal bests, collect 24 fish species and try the three-game Daily Mix. Every game, every level and all three fishing shores are available from first launch. Fill your fish album by making catches.

MADE FOR YOUR WATCH
• Independent Apple Watch app; no companion app required.
• Games, artwork, sounds and content bundled for offline play.
• Local progress, favorites, achievements and fish album.
• Optional sound effects and haptics.
• Crown direction and sensitivity settings, reduced motion, and symbols with colors.
• Gameplay pauses when you leave, with deliberate Resume when you return.

No ads, subscriptions, in-app purchases or app account. Requires Apple Watch with watchOS 10 or later. This is an Apple Watch game collection, with no playable iPhone or iPad app.

Support: https://dvpdesign.pro/crownook/support.html
Privacy: https://dvpdesign.pro/crownook/privacy.html
en.subtitle: Offline Arcade & Puzzles
